gwisp_bite.label: Leans in, a tongue of flame reaching for you

gwisp_death.label: Goes out: a thread of smoke

cwisp_death.label: Goes out: a thread of smoke

deacon_attack.label: Lifts the lantern-staff high, straight up (the tell)
Drives it straight down on you: dust (held)

mender_attack.label: Pulls a hand back to the chest (the tell)

summoner_attack.label: Pulls the ember in to his chest (the tell)
Shoves it at you, it flares
Sparks spit off it into you (held)

summoner_death.label: Death: drops to its knees, the ember drops and goes out
Face down, lies there a moment

summoner_death_2.label: Death: the eyes dim, he rocks back

summoner_death_3.label: Death: embers catch at the hem
They climb, the robe charring black
Falls in: a heap of ash, one ember left

acolyte_attack.label: Swings the censer up over his head (the tell)
Brings it round on its chain
It smashes into you, embers jump (held)

acolyte_death.label: Death: drops to its knees, the censer drops
Face down, lies there a moment

acolyte_death_2.label: Death: the eyes dim, he rocks back

acolyte_death_3.label: Death: embers catch at the hem
They climb, the robe charring black
Falls in: a heap of ash, one ember left

gnaw_screech.label: Squeal (at 2/3 and 1/3 health): rears up, jaws wide
Screeches: sound lines from his jaws, shaking

gnaw_hole.label: A wall hole in the den (as today)
Squeal: the dirt round the hole cracks
A rat's snout pokes out of the dark
It scrabbles out onto the floor
